summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, Levels 1–5 and M.E.G. Base Gamma, assembled from authored place cells, per-place simulations and shared player, creature and NPC systems. Players scavenge, fight, build and talk; Level 5's hotel includes resident services and a Beverly Room mahjong table with guest lifecycle managed by the table and place systems.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, breakable furniture, shifting walls, smilers and lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, supplies, NPCs, hounds, sludge and damaging steam vents.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze/crawl halls, hazards, lore set pieces, creature brigades and Gamma checkpoint; generators and lifts connect deeper levels.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards, residents and locked Database terminal.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; offices, fountains, break-room vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega; sim lays residents and office systems/tasks.
places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; Main Hall, guest rooms, Beverly Room and Boiler Room; residents, Housekeeping, rentals, elevators and mahjong.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion precedes movement; interaction, gameplay and critter handlers run before scripts/view3.js.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position, computer/seated/death views, talk close-up and pulled-back third-person view.
places/<place>/sim.js - place setup/tick roots; simulations assemble geometry, residents, encounters and exits; Level 4/5 also lay place systems.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 3 objects.scene hosts visits, Level 5 x0z0.scene hosts hotel fixtures and managers.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays for transitions, loot, talk, build, stats, craft, OS, horde, lockpick and mahjong; seated mahjong replaces the regular HUD.
scripts/view3.js - player-chain input handler maps held thirdPerson to player.state.tp; scripts/camera.js consumes it.
scripts/stats.js - K opens the HALOGEN sheet for attribute/skill spending; opening it clears the pending level-up prompt.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + Level 0 data, scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with data - per-level grids/layouts reused by sims, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + Level 3 data + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim, creatures and visits.
scripts/lib/level4.js and scripts/lib/level5.js - office/hotel plans, zones, openings, exits and sanity data shared by geometry, place systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + l5-hall-kit.js and scripts/lib/l5-boiler-plan.js - hotel furnishing/door plan and boiler coordinates shared by geometry and active lay/heat scripts.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml; scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - place NPC definitions, rounds, speech, resident spawning and simulation helpers.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js + npc-lore.yml, scripts/lib/voices.js + scripts/lib/hear.js - shared NPC traits and spatial voice/speech path used by dialogue, barks and residents.
scripts/lib/hunt.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - Level 0 hunters share hearing, pack-alert, light-visibility and last-sighting/lead calculations.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4/5 also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level2.js - grid/layout queries and deterministic sludge sites; scripts/lib/level4.js and level5.js - plan constants and queries.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js - PEOPLE5, roundsOf, speak, spawnResident, tickPeople; scripts/l5-elevator.js - destIndex, ears, update.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - clothing/look/roll helpers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph/baseBones helpers; scripts/lib/seat.js - seat claims/sit/stand.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js - lifeOf and fear/want data; scripts/lib/voices.js - throatOf, vo; scripts/lib/npc-talk.js - dialogue config, prompts, parsing and checks.
scripts/lib/clock.js - game clock; scripts/lib/hear.js - heard; scripts/lib/npc-starters.js - dialogue starters/choices.
scripts/lib/mahjong.js - tile/rule, fan scoring, shanten and call helpers; scripts/lib/hunt.js - hearing/alert/sighting helpers; scripts/meg-agent.js - nerveOf, onSpawn, bark, update, vanish.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, hunger/thirst, cents, visits, kills/deaths and combat; publishes recent loud actions for hunters.
scripts/stats.js - player.state HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; recipes validate skill/materials; craft also owns hunger/thirst drain and food/water use.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing and spawned creatures carry owner horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot/interaction and player sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns player.state pick/pickP/pickR, bobby pins and boiler-pick timestamp; seats own occupancy.

scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - dialogue, social memory and NPC follow state; meg-agent owns routines, nerve, chosen arm, combat, fear/want reactions and gestures; l5-resident grants the boiler key by Speech check, and l5-door grants it during Harlan escort.
scripts/mahjong.js + Level 5 table state - player.state.mj, cents paid/won and session mjLive; table owns mjGuests roster/solo play/travel lifecycle; boiler door state owns open/hinge/swing.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered handlers: locomotion precedes movement; interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick and horde process before critter and view3 handlers.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; player/enemy gaze and targeting read camera; talkWith, seats and sit state alter view.

scripts/view3.js reads held thirdPerson → player.state.tp; scripts/camera.js eases a shoulder camera behind the player, raycasts to shorten it near walls, hides the local avatar during transition and suppresses it while seated/talking/mahjong.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 lifts → Levels 4/5, Level 4 stairs → Level 5; hotel lift/stairs return to Level 3/4.
scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; place sims place inbound markers and player.js selects safe spawn/door checkpoints after death.

scripts/player.js writes state.xfer → scripts/ui.js draws named transition card; player.js gain() writes xpPop → UI renders aggregated XP; lvlPrompt prompts K and stats.js clears it when opening the sheet.

interact.js E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits choices/text/trade → talk.js/NPC ears; talk.js parses join intent and escort-like spoken promises into NPC state.follow; npc-talk.js builds lore/memory-informed prompts and replies update rapport; resident/agent speech uses voices.js + hear.js.

Harlan's resident card option → scripts/l5-resident.js checks Speech 25 and writes player.state.l5boilerKey; scripts/interact.js targets the parented boiler panel at its world position and routes E to press, while Lockpick 25 can start the boiler pick; l5-door.js grants the key and opens when a following, living Harlan is within 60 m (or the player already has the key), and the door also opens from the boiler side.
scripts/player.js writes state.loud on swings/shots → scripts/lib/hunt.js hearOf uses recent fight/gunshot radius as well as movement noise; crouching suppresses movement but not fighting noise.
smilers/lurkers spot a player → hunt.raise writes place.state.l0alert → nearby hunters read alertFor and pursue; hunt.litMul and player dark state adjust detection.
places/main/sim.js seeds modeled breakable/sunken furniture and containers; scripts/grab.js can pull sunken props with Z and combat can break them; loot.js supplies container contents.

E at l5-ball-mahjong → scripts/mahjong.js sits player and writes table.state.mjGuests → l5-ball.js spawns/moves/sits guests; after host departure/timeout guests continue solo play then walk out/despawn; mahjong.js writes player.state.mj phase/results.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0 groups hotel detail by room tags.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office structure, non-colliding detail, varied props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - agent/resident rounds and talk vary by faction, role, voice, look/build and routine; meg-agent.js adds deterministic nerve, arm loadout and flee behavior.
scripts/smilers.js and lurkers.js use lib/hunt.js hearing and lost-trail prediction, but retain different light/gaze, pursuit and attack rules; hounds, stealers and deathmoths have distinct pursuit.

scripts/mahjong.js + mahjong.yml + mahjong-looks.yml - shared game lifecycle and rules vary among six guests by persona, suit preference, species/look, dialogue and call/sloppiness; l5-ball.js handles solo continuation and guest cleanup.

scripts/l5-hall-lay.js + l5-hall-geo.js/l5-hall-fix.js - Main Hall furnishings/fixtures derive from layout rows; hotel elevator banks vary geometry; grab.js shares lift/throw/break behavior across eligible props.

scripts/lib/vmpose.js - first-person melee poses share five swing styles by weapon class; clubs combo and fists alternate; empty pistols use slide-stop motion, while shotguns cycle a shell push per reloadShell.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m (hub cells 26–29); Level 1 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 64×64 m with 8 m offices; Level 5 96×60 m, x ±48/z ±30. Level 0 creature recovery uses positions relative to its maze.

Level 0 weapons no longer replenish as loose pickups; find weapons in desks, cabinets, backpacks or containers. Lobby Wafers use token lobby_wafer; food tokens are applied in player.js and configured through item/loot and level data.

NPC held weapon props need state.kind; meg-agent.js preserves non-pistol spawner arms, can use explicit state.arm: fists, otherwise rolls by role/faction and nerve, then controls hand/back visibility and ranged/melee attacks.

Mahjong uses cents (100-cent stake per seat) and tile IDs d/b/c + 1–9, w1–w4 winds and r1–r3 dragons; table guest IDs/state must stay aligned with MJ visitor keys, stools and l5-ball cleanup/solo lifecycle.
First-person reload poses read loaded_<kind>, reloadTime, reloadStart and reloadShell from weapon data; keep empty-mag detection and per-shell shotgun timing aligned with player.js reload state.

Third-person input is the held thirdPerson action (middle mouse) written by scripts/view3.js to player.state.tp; scripts/camera.js reads it and raycasts against physics to prevent the shoulder camera crossing walls.
